name: Kapra
tagline: Eastern residential area around Kapra Lake
about: Kapra sits on the eastern side near ECIL and Sainikpuri, with Kapra Lake as its landmark. It is a settled residential area with a long-standing local population rather than a new corridor.

Apartments and independent houses dominate. Pricing is among the more accessible in the city for a fully serviced area, and demand is driven largely by proximity to eastern employment centres and the defence establishments.

connectivity.label: Metro
connectivity.detail: Blue Line terminus at Nagole, then road

faq.q: Is the east side worth considering for investment?
faq.a: It is more of a rental-yield and affordability story than a rapid-appreciation one. If your budget is tighter and you want a serviced area rather than a developing layout, it deserves a look.
